instruction: A candid full-length snapshot of two women dancing on an outdoor balcony with a metal railing, surrounded by lush green trees. On the left, the strawberry-blonde woman in the magenta dress (R2) dances with her arms raised, looking downward with a soft smile. On the right, the red-haired woman in the black halter dress and black ankle boots (R1) dances alongside her, arms raised high, smiling joyfully. The two dance in a carefree, synchronized manner side-by-side. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight filtering through the background foliage, creating a bright and lively atmosphere with gentle shadows.
